resources.string: %1$s is not installed on this server. Install it to use this feature.
The address changed or no external app could open it. Refresh and try again.
HTTPS through a local forward needs a certificate valid for 127.0.0.1. The browser validates it normally; no TLS validation override is provided.

Open with a system browser or external app. Client login credentials are not attached. The address is not a reachability check. If HTTPS fails, repair the hostname, certificate and trust chain or choose a trusted published endpoint.
The linked site binding is unavailable or outside current permissions. Open the website manager to inspect it.
For remote loopback or a managed login, create a user SSH local forward to server port %1$d in Server Centre, then open its actual phone address.
